rationale: Empty with 3 free but 4 requested: each qty-2 fits alone but both together overbook to 4/3. Classic check-then-insert race should be exposed.
Empty exact fit: 4 free for 4 requested so both should succeed. Concurrent read-modify-write can lose one counter update leaving reserved=2 with two rows, exposing reserved vs sum divergence.
Nearly full with prior holder amy 3, leaving 2 free: only one qty-2 should succeed. Stale read of reserved/sum can overbook to 7/5.
Full with prior holder jack 2, leaving 0 free: both qty-2 should be rejected. Any insert overbooks and second jack row tests duplicate-holder and unique-constraint races.
